data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'a'jala, meaning 'to hope' or 'to wish'. In Islamic tradition, Ojala is a name that evokes a sense of optimism and trust in the divine. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ojala usually hope their child will grow to embody hope, wish and live with faith, good character and purpose.
